bonus_actions.desc: The redcap kicks a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Red Cap
special_abilities.desc: The redcap must soak its cap in the blood of a Humanoid that has been dead for no more than 1 hour at least once every 3 days. Every 24 hours past the third day that it goes without soaking its cap in blood in this way, it suffers one level of exhaustion. This exhaustion can be reduced only when the redcap finishes a long rest after soaking its cap in fresh Humanoid blood, which reduces its exhaustion level to 0. If the redcap dies as a result of this exhaustion, it crumbles to dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rift swine makes one Tusk attack and two Tentacle attacks, or it makes three Warping Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The rift swine has two tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Warping Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d6 + 1) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls as reality-warping energies temporarily distort its body.

special_abilities.name: Chaos Mutations
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the rift swine’s body experiences a mutation. Choose an option or roll a d6 to determine the type of mutation. The mutation lasts until the start of the rift swine’s next turn.

special_abilities.name: Dozens of Eyes
special_abilities.desc: The rift swine has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight and on saving throws against being blinded. In addition, if the rift swine isn’t blinded, creatures attacking it can’t benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature’s allies distracting or surrounding the rift swine, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack class feature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rime worm makes two Rime Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Freeze Prey.

actions.name: Rime Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the rime worm doesn't have another creature grappled.

actions.name: Freeze Prey
actions.desc: One creature grappled by the rime worm must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be petrified in ice for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A petrified creature that takes fire damage has advantage on the saving throw.

actions.name: Black Ice Spray
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The rime worm sprays slivers of ice in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area then becomes icy, difficult terrain for 1 minute.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The rime worm can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Icy Body
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the rime worm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) cold damage.

special_abilities.name: Snow Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The rime worm has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

special_abilities.name: Snow Stride
special_abilities.desc: The rime worm can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud. In addition, difficult terrain composed of snow or ice doesn’t cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Rime Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The rime worm grub can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Ravenous Larva
special_abilities.desc: The rime worm grub can make an opportunity attack against any creature that leaves its reach, even if the creature takes the Disengage action. In addition, it has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its hp.

special_abilities.name: Snow Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The rime worm grub has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

special_abilities.name: Snow Stride
special_abilities.desc: The rime worm grub can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud. In addition, difficult terrain composed of snow or ice doesn’t cost it extra movement.

tob-2023_risen-reaver.name: Risen Reaver
tob-2023_risen-reaver.languages: the languages it knew in life

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The risen reaver makes three Bladed Fist attacks.

actions.name: Bladed Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Skitter
bonus_actions.desc: The risen reaver takes the Dash action.

reactions.name: Infused Arsenal
reactions.desc: When the risen reaver is hit with a nonmagical melee weapon or when it starts its turn in the same space as a nonmagical melee weapon that isn't being worn or carried, it absorbs the weapon into its body. If the weapon is being wielded by an attacker, the attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or lose its weapon. For 1 minute, the reaver has resistance to the type of damage dealt by that weapon, and when it hits with its Bladed Fist, the fist deals an extra 2 (1d4) damage of the type dealt by the weapon. The reaver can absorb no more than three weapons in this way every 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Blood Sense
special_abilities.desc: The risen reaver can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren’t Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The risen reaver doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

tob-2023_river-king.name: River King
tob-2023_river-king.senses: darkvision 120 ft., blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 16
tob-2023_river-king.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The River King makes two Longsword or Flood Blast attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Flood Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away from the River King and knocked prone.

actions.name: Grasping Whirlpool
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The River King magically creates a swirling vortex of water centered on a point he can see within 60 feet. The vortex appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 15 feet tall with a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage and is restrained. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, isn't restrained, and can choose to be pushed out of the whirlpool's space. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. While restrained, a creature is unable to breathe unless it can breathe water, and it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take an action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 18 Strength check. A creature with a swimming speed has advantage on the saving throw and on the Strength check to escape.

actions.desc:

- **3/Day Each:** freedom of movement, control water
1/day: control weather (as an action)

reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet of the River King stands up from prone, he can make one Longsword attack against that creature.

legendary_actions.name: Flow
legendary_actions.desc: The River King moves up to his walking speed, or swims up to half his swimming speed, without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Ripple

The River King magically ripples like sunlight on the surface of water. Until the start of his next turn, attack rolls against him have disadvantage.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If the River King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Riparian Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The River King’s weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 10 (3d6) poison damage (included in the attack).

tob-2023_rotting-wind.name: Rotting Wind
tob-2023_rotting-wind.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rotting wind makes two Wind of Decay attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract the tomb rot disease (see the Tomb Rot trait).

actions.name: Wind of Decay
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the rotting wind's space. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

special_abilities.name: Air Form
special_abilities.desc: The rotting wind can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Invisibility
special_abilities.desc: The rotting wind is invisible.

special_abilities.name: Poisonous Aura
special_abilities.desc: The rotting wind radiates an aura of poison and decay that slowly pollutes the area within 30 feet of it. Each hour the rotting wind stays in a place, nonmagical plants in the aura begin to wither, and water in the aura becomes poisoned. Nonmagical plants in the aura for 24 hours die. A creature that drinks water poisoned by the aura must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract the tomb rot disease (see the Tomb Rot trait). Creatures immune to the poisoned condition are immune to this disease.

special_abilities.name: Tomb Rot
special_abilities.desc: A creature infested with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 days after infection, which include muscle weakness and rotten-smelling breath as its body rots from the inside out. Until the disease is cured, at the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and suffer one level of exhaustion. This exhaustion lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws recovers from the disease.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The rotting wind doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.desc:

The rubezahl calls a sizzling bolt of lightning out of the sky, or from the air if underground or indoors, to strike a point the rubezahl can see within 150 feet of it. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 36 (8d8) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't stunned.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:

- **3/Day Each:** gust of wind, sleet storm
1/day: control weather (as an action)

special_abilities.name: Counting Compulsion
special_abilities.desc: If a creature uses an action to point out an ordered group of objects that the rubezahl can see, such as a pile of gravel, the demon is compelled to count the entire group. Until the end of its next turn, the rubezahl has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and it can’t take reactions. Once it has counted a given group of objects, it can’t be compelled to count those objects again.

special_abilities.name: False Tongue
special_abilities.desc: The rubezahl has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. In addition, magical attempts to discern lies always report that the rubezahl’s words are true, and it can’t be magically forced to tell the truth.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The rubezahl has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Aura of Drunkenness
special_abilities.desc: The rum gremlin radiates an aura of drunkenness to a radius of 20 feet. Each creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. A creature that has consumed alcohol within the past hour has disadvantage on the saving throw. While poisoned, a creature falls prone if it tries to move more than half its speed during a turn. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the rum gremlin’s Aura of Drunkenness for 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The rum gremlin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.desc: The drake makes one Bite attack and two Tail Swipe attacks.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or contract the rust drake lockjaw disease (see the Rust Drake Lockjaw trait).

actions.name: Tail Swipe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Vomit Scrap
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The rust drake vomits forth a 15-foot cone of rusted metal. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) slashing damage and 22 (5d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, each creature that failed the saving throw must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or contract the rust drake lockjaw disease (see the Rust Drake Lockjaw trait).

special_abilities.name: Rust Drake Lockjaw
special_abilities.desc: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 days after infection, which include painful muscle spasms, particularly in the jaw. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 hour and have its Dexterity score reduced by 1d4. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. If the disease reduces the creature’s Dexterity to 0, the creature dies. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws recovers from the disease.
